_comment: VCWCode sample overlay. Copy to config/local.json and edit. Keys mirror default.json; underscore keys are comments only and ignored by the loader.
_docs: See VCWCODE-PORTS-NOTES.md (ports), VCWCODE-ENGINES-NOTES.md (webEngine), VCWCODE-ENV-CHECKLIST.md (env keys). Validate with vcwcode-schema.json.
_serverPort_note: Desktop API port, 1-65535. Default 42069. Change only on conflict; update gameUrl/static host accordingly.
_webEngine_note: ultralight (default, lightweight) | electron | chromium. Env override: VIBE_WEB_ENGINE.
_provider_note: Chat provider id. Default 'meta' in default.json.
_localUrl_note: Local chat endpoint, e.g. Ollama http://localhost:11434/api/chat.
_gameUrl_note: Playtest game URL from the static host on port 8888.
